# David Hou

> I'm a product builder and operator working at the intersection of education and AI. I believe AI will change the way we learn, and I'm passionate about building the best interface for that shift.

## About

I'm currently at Decagon (https://decagon.ai), building AI products that help our customers learn the platform and our internal teams work more effectively. On the customer side, I work on everything that helps users get the most out of Decagon: building interactive learning products, creating tools and automations that power our content, and running workshops and onsites for our most strategic accounts. Internally, I'm building Arc, our AI workspace and company brain, which helps everyone at Decagon ramp faster and be more productive, from learning the platform to building agents and running deployments.

Previously, I was at MongoDB, where I led documentation for our AI products (Voyage AI, Vector Search, MongoDB MCP Server), building tutorials, sample apps, and code for developers. I also served as my team's AI technologist: evaluating new AI tooling, building workflows that made our team more productive, and creating a culture of innovative yet responsible AI use. Before that, I did technical and UX writing at New Relic. In college, I was Co-Editor-in-Chief of the Yale Record, America's oldest humor magazine.

I live in NYC.

## 0 to 1 Product Initiatives (Decagon)

- Decagon University: Customer learning program, from fundamentals courses to hands-on labs inside the product.
- AI Tutor: Voice agent that walks customers through the platform live and answers questions in real time.
- Self-updating docs and slides: Agents that update docs and enablement decks as the product ships. 95% of doc updates are automated, and 10+ teams have adopted it.
- Arc: Internal AI workspace that answers questions from company knowledge and takes action in connected tools, right in Slack.
- Compass: AI learning platform that ramps every internal team. In development.
- Claude Tag: Claude in the customer team's channels, built with Anthropic, for instant answers, bug triage, and request intake.

## Personal Projects

- [Prompt Saver MCP Server](https://github.com/davidhou17/prompt-saver-mcp): Saves successful LLM conversation threads as reusable prompts for future tasks.
- [Local Docs Evals](https://github.com/davidhou17/local-docs-eval): A fully local evaluation suite for documentation repositories.
- [MongoDB Education MCP Server](https://github.com/mongodb/chatbot/tree/prompt_maxxing/packages/mcp): Finalist in MongoDB's company hackathon (top 8% of submissions).
- [LangGraph MongoDB Movie Agent](https://github.com/davidhou17/langgraph-mongodb-movie-agent): A conversational agent using MongoDB for agentic RAG and short- and long-term memory.

## Speaking

- [AI the Docs 2025](https://pronovix.com/event/ai-the-docs-2025/david-hou): "Rethinking Docs as Code in the Age of Vibe Coding"

## DevEx Content (MongoDB)

- [Jupyter Notebooks for AI Developers](https://github.com/mongodb/docs-notebooks): Collection of Jupyter notebooks for AI development.
- [Natural Language to MongoDB](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/natural-language-to-mongodb/): Guide to using LLMs to convert natural language into MongoDB queries.
- [Build AI Agents with MongoDB](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/atlas-vector-search/ai-agents/): Foundational guide to building AI agents with MongoDB.
- [MongoDB MCP Server](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mcp-server/): Docs for the MongoDB MCP Server.
- [Voyage AI by MongoDB](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/voyageai): Docs for Voyage AI's embedding and reranking models.
- [MongoDB Vector Search](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/atlas-vector-search/vector-search-overview/): Docs for MongoDB Vector Search.
- [AI Framework and Platform Integrations](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/ai-integrations/): Docs for MongoDB's AI integrations.
